column1: # Positions of appendicularian clades tested by AU tests (stage2/machinery_lba.py, analysis hypotheses; make
# selenoprotein-au). Clades: expressions of leaf sets, separated by ";" when a hypothesis has several clades; terms
# joined by " + " (union) and " - " (difference): app, appclade:<regex>, mrca:<regex>, group:<taxonomic group>
# (also vertebrates, chordates, animals, non-animals), re:<regex>. The O. dioica leaves are the gold-standard proteins (OKI_gold_<gene>).
# Step 8 of the plan of 2026-10-24: SELENOF, SELENOO and SELENOT place the appendicularian clade outside the animal or
# tunicate clade in the first-pass trees, and SELENOW_PAR is sister to the SELENOV of placental mammals. DIO added
# (2026-10-29): with the taxonomy of stage2/taxonomy.py, the nearest relatives of the selenocysteine DIO clades in the
# first-pass tree, curated DIO_PAR and DIO_chr1 included, are alveolate and amoebozoan DIO (bootstrap 59 to 66).
# Controls (2026-10-30): where the reference group of a hypothesis is not a clade of the round 2 trees (non-chordate
# sequences among the chordate ones, for example), the same group as a clade with the appendicularian clade outside it,
# so that a rejection of the hypothesis can be told from a rejection of the monophyly of the group. with_SELENOV:
# position of SELENOW_PAR in the PMSF tree of round 2 (sister to the mammalian SELENOV), tested under both models.
